title.narrative: Let’s Talk Youth Talk”: to shape the life of others to achieve sustainable goals

description.narrative: The project aims to create a dedicated youth forum for young individuals to voice their opinions, concerns, and ideas. The forum will be guided by professionals in specific fields, fostering constructive dialogue and active engagement. The aim is to empower young people to contribute to decision-making processes and shape their surroundings. The forum will also encourage active participation, foster collaboration, enhance decision-making skills, amplify youth voices, and promote positive change. The proposed topics include developing leadership potential, dealing with emotions, speaking up, addressing violence, leveraging social media, promoting SDG strategies, and promoting self-defense. Both sessions will be competition sessions.
